question: Her ülkenin adı ve o ülkeye bağlı şehir sayısı kaçtır?
golden_sql: SELECT co.CountryName, COUNT(*) AS SEHIR_SAYISI FROM Application.Cities ci JOIN Application.StateProvinces sp ON sp.StateProvinceID = ci.StateProvinceID JOIN Application.Countries co ON co.CountryID = sp.CountryID GROUP BY co.CountryName ORDER BY co.CountryName
sql:
SELECT c.CountryName AS CountryName,
       COUNT(ci.CityID) AS CityCount
FROM Application.Countries c
LEFT JOIN Application.StateProvinces sp ON sp.CountryID = c.CountryID
LEFT JOIN Application.Cities ci ON ci.StateProvinceID = sp.StateProvinceID
GROUP BY c.CountryName
ORDER BY CityCount DESC, c.CountryName ASC
answer_text: 190 ülke arasında United States 37.940 CityCount değeriyle öne çıkıyor; gösterilen diğer ülkelerde CityCount 0.

question: Kredi notları hariç, faturanın kesildiği müşterinin teslimat şehrinin eyaletine göre toplam ciro nedir?
golden_sql: SELECT sp.StateProvinceName, SUM(il.ExtendedPrice - il.TaxAmount) AS CIRO FROM Sales.InvoiceLines il JOIN Sales.Invoices i ON i.InvoiceID = il.InvoiceID JOIN Sales.Customers c ON c.CustomerID = i.BillToCustomerID JOIN Application.Cities ci ON ci.CityID = c.DeliveryCityID JOIN Application.StateProvinces sp ON sp.StateProvinceID = ci.StateProvinceID WHERE i.IsCreditNote = 0 GROUP BY sp.StateProvinceName ORDER BY sp.StateProvinceName
